answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops fake identities. To claim one slot, an agent burns a deposit of twice its 30-day earnings, like reserving one bed in a shared garden: yarrow and juniper each need their own plot, and no one plants a thousand seedlings for the price of one. Forging 1,000 identities burns 1,000 deposits, $20,000 at $20 each, more than fake votes earn. An honest agent pays once, keeps its slot by real work, and earns undiluted rewards.
